name: My ga tan
summary: Mỳ gà tần is braised chicken with egg noodles. Vietnam Tourism says the chicken, regular or the smaller black-skinned bird, is simmered in an empty drink can with herbs that include mugwort, then egg noodles go into the stew.
origin: Hanoi, on Vietnam Tourism’s Hanoi street-food article.
howToEat: Choose the regular chicken or the black-skinned chicken. The guide says the black bird is slightly more expensive and does not print the price.
The chickens go into empty soda or beer cans with aromatic herbs, including mugwort. Egg noodles are added to the stew.
where: Vietnam Tourism’s Hanoi street-food article does not name a street. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: My ga tan — Hanoi herbal chicken noodles
seoDescription: Mỳ gà tần in Hanoi is braised chicken and egg noodles. Vietnam Tourism describes chicken simmered in a can with mugwort and other herbs.
